meta.title: Plugin development toolkit
meta.description: Adds plugin-development help to Creator mode only. Creator mode gains the dsh_plugin_check tool, which reports the structural problems that stop a bundle from installing or displaying, and the dsh-plugin-isolated-test skill, which describes how to test a plugin in a dsh web instance with its own DSH_HOME, profile, and port. Other presets gain nothing. Removing the bundle removes the tool and the skill with it; the Creator-mode preset falls back to the shipped declaration. The tool is read-only and needs an absolute bundle directory; it does not parse the patch file as YAML, so it cannot catch YAML syntax errors.
